newsitem.title: JAPAN: Toyota Motor shares down on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Toyota Motor shares down on profit-taking.

text.p: Toyota Motor Corp shares were weak in Monday afternoon trade, as profit-taking kicked in despite an upward revision of its earnings forecast for the full business year, brokers said.
As of 0439 GMT, its shares were 20 yen lower at 2,820 yen on volume of 2.036 billion shares. It was the 11th most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
On Friday, Toyota said its parent current profit was expected to hit 550.00 billion yen in the year to March 31, 1997, against 340.73 billion in the previous year.
